title: Cruise — Warsaw to Rīga
description: Air Baltic A220 at cruise altitude over Poland, inbound Riga. FL350. Live METAR. Baltic Sea ahead to the left.
author: Markus Leutwyler

atcClearances.pm: Warsaw control, Airbaltic, flight level three five zero, estimating Riga in fifty minutes
atcClearances.atc: Airbaltic, Warsaw control, radar contact, maintain flight level three five zero
Airbaltic, contact Vilnius control on one three four decimal two seven five

atcClearances.pm: Vilnius control, Airbaltic, flight level three five zero
atcClearances.atc: Airbaltic, Vilnius control, identified, maintain flight level three five zero
Airbaltic, descend flight level two four zero, contact Riga control on one two three decimal five

approachBrief.t: destination, Riga, Echo Victor Romeo Alpha. runway three six. ILS approach, frequency one ten decimal three
initial approach altitude, three thousand feet. final approach course, three six zero degrees
decision height, two hundred feet. minimums set
missed approach: climb runway heading to two thousand, then right turn direct Riga VOR
vee app one three zero knots. flaps full. landing checklist after gear down

debrief: Was FL350 cruise stable — did the AP hold altitude?
Did you catch the Baltic Sea approaching from the left?
Was the descent clearance handled on time?
How was the Baltic light during the descent?
